weak_scope_prediction.reference: Frozen train support question rule and VQA metadata for evaluation only; not clinical certification.

limitations: All English validation, but observed 96 images; no blind/test claim.
All 39 supported questions are historical development observations, not an independent efficacy replication.
913 additional questions test new offscope behavior on previously observed images.
Weak rule scope labels and original QA answers are not independent clinical verification.
External base fallback does not show single-adapter parameter retention.
Shared exact branch records and two frozen adapter seeds do not create extra independent generations or patients.
No unconditional-adapter whole-cohort score is computed for unobserved branches.
